status.label: Duplicate service-start report
status.detail: The same start-then-stop behavior is already tracked in issue 27897.

next_action.label: Consolidate service evidence
next_action.reason: Keep investigation with the established service-start report; no separate fix is proposed.

judgment.rationale: The reporter describes the service stopping immediately after it starts, and a human follow-up points to existing reports in 27897. The earlier issue independently describes service mode turning itself off and breaking connectivity.
evidence: The body reports PowerToys 0.80.0, both Windows 11 machines affected, and a Service stopped successfully event.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/32291#issuecomment-2040977868 identifies the same reports in issue 27897.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/27897 remains OPEN and describes service mode reverting to off.
Tracking overview https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/51077 groups both issues under service mode.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate this symptom with 27897; do not infer a crash from a successful-stop event or start a competing design.

fix_assessment.rationale: A separate implementation for this duplicate report is not applicable. The canonical service-start issue is still unresolved; the tracking overview is not itself a fix.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Without Borders service starts and then stops on two Windows 11 machines; the same service-mode failure is already tracked in issue 27897.
known_information: The reporter compared this with a working standalone Mouse Without Borders 2.2.1.327 installation.
The reported Event Viewer entry is a successful stop, not a supplied faulting-module crash.
A human comment and the module tracking overview identify the established service-start cluster.
inferences: The shared service lifecycle symptom supports consolidation, but does not identify a specific service termination mechanism.
issue_context.analysis: Use concrete duplicate evidence rather than the stale empty-assignee ownership claim. Neither the duplicate report nor the overview proves an implemented correction.
initial_investigation: Read the entire body and both comments, plus the linked canonical issue body.
Checked all cross-references and the tracking overview's explicit service cluster.
